title: MLZ governance
description: Customer-wide settings for governance. Any setting in mlz-core's governance/defaults.yaml can be overridden here.

name.description: The customer's name, for people reading this file.

root_id.description: The prefix of every management group ID and many resource names: 2 to 16 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

root_display_name.description: The top management group's display name.

primary_region.description: Where the platform's own resources go; one of allowed_regions.

security_contact.description: Defender for Cloud's security alerts go to this email address.

parent_management_group_id.description: An existing management group to build the tree below, instead of the tenant root.

subscriptions.description: The platform subscriptions, each moved into the management group of the same name. management and connectivity are required.

allowed_regions.description: Regions resources and resource groups may be created in.

management_groups.description: The optional management groups: security under Platform, local under Landing Zones.

tags.description: Tag policies. A key given here replaces the default's whole list.

required.description: Tags required on every resource group in the landing zones (deny).

inherited.description: Tags copied from the resource group to resources that lack them (modify).

exempt_resource_groups.description: Resource groups Azure creates itself, where the required tags are not enforced. One * per pattern.

in_sandboxes.description: Whether sandboxes must tag their resource groups too.

policy_assignments_to_remove.description: ALZ policy assignments to leave out, by archetype.

naming.description: How mlz-core names what it creates (docs/naming.md).

org.description: The customer's code in every name: 2 to 4 lower-case letters and digits (default: the root ID).

template.description: How names are made (default: {type}-{org}-{app}-{purpose}-{env}-{region}-{nn}). Tokens in braces, dashes and lower-case text; an empty {purpose} drops out.

templates.description: A template for one type, for the 24-character ones (storage_account, key_vault).

environments.description: A landing zone file's name to its environment's short name, added to or replacing mlz-core's (dev: dv, test: te, uat: ut, sit: st, qa: qa, preprod: pp, sandbox: sb, dr: dr, prod: pd).

regions.description: An Azure region to its short name, replacing Microsoft's code; before the first deployment only.

repository.description: How a landing zone's workload repo is named (default: {app}-{env}), with long names: {app} the workload's folder, {env} the landing zone's file, {org} the customer's code. Both {app} and {env} are needed.

platform.description: A part of the platform to its short name in names, replacing mlz-core's (hub: hub, dns: dns, management: mgt, identity: idn, bootstrap: mlz). The platform's environment is prod.

advanced.description: Module inputs mlz-core leaves at the module's default, by module call (alz, management); anything else is refused with what owns it.

alz.description: Module inputs mlz-core leaves at the module's default, as the module names them (docs/reference/governance.md lists them). Anything else is refused with what owns it.

management.description: Module inputs mlz-core leaves at the module's default, as the module names them (docs/reference/governance.md lists them). Anything else is refused with what owns it.
